feature: Rust array-to-pointer conversions at typed consumers

breadth.scope: Recursive paired AST comparison permits a raw mutable address plus a pointer cast only at the corresponding original expression. At that location, up to seven prior pointer casts may be subsumed; their targets and the new consumer target are recorded. Place expressions, operands, integer casts, calls, ordering and all surrounding AST remain identical. Pointer targets are not proven by old syntax. This does not prove whole-program native equivalence or arbitrary field-base validity.
limitations: Whole-program native equivalence and full runtime type correctness are not established by structural comparison.
New result pointer types and subsumed pointer casts are recorded; old syntax alone cannot prove the consumer type.
Array field projection still requires valid containing storage; arbitrary null/dangling bases are not covered.
Unresolved global/local array forms and load/store access bounds are outside this change.
Raw inherited parser failures retain diagnostics; identifier-only normalization is review-only.
Registered native proof is x86_64 with Rust overflow-checks=off and C-fwrapv. No multiarchitecture native parity claim.
